articles.title: Do Frontier Models Seek Safety Evidence Before Acting?
articles.title_zh: Do Frontier Models Seek Safety Evidence Before Acting?
articles.description:
arXiv:2609.17865v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Frontier models are often evaluated on how they respond to safety information once it is already in context. We study an earlier decision point: whether models choose to acquire safety-relevant evidence before acting. We introduce SAFE, a controlled benchmark in which models make deployment decisions with optional evidence that varies in retrieval cost, probability, severity, and presentation.
